website.how: The site's heading reads "Belinda Fox Spencer | Candidate for U.S. Congress WV, District 1" and names the Constitution Party and 2026.

The site names Carol Miller as a Representative in Congress for West Virginia and is paid for by Carol for Congress; its visible text gives no district number (its logo file is still labelled WV-CD03, the number of her seat before 2023).
The site names Vince George "for West Virginia's 1st Congressional District".
The site names Ace Parsi as a candidate for Congress in West Virginia's second district.
The site names Riley Moore for Congress in West Virginia and is paid for by Moore for West Virginia, Inc.
The site names Rachel Fetty Anderson as running for U.S. Senate in West Virginia.

offices.source: Her campaign's own site: "In 2017 Rachel was elected to the Morgantown City Council and served until 2021."

website.how: The site is titled "Rio for U.S. Senate 2026 | Working Class Independent for West Virginia"; the home page gives the given name only, and the site's About page (/about) carries the full name in its footer, "Rio Phillips for West Virginia".
The site names S. Marshall Wilson for U.S. Senate, West Virginia, 2026, and the Constitution Party.

born.source: Wikipedia's article on S. Marshall Wilson, citing the West Virginia Blue Book 2017-2018; the article says he is the Constitution Party candidate for U.S. Senate in 2026
